questions.stem: A 35-year-old woman comes because of a 2-month history of difficulty sleeping, worsening fatigue, difficulty concentrating and remembering tasks at work as well as diminished interest in her hobbies. She has no suicidal or homicidal thoughts. She does not have auditory or visual hallucinations. The physician prescribes sertraline. Two weeks later, the patient comes again with only minor improvements in her symptoms. Which is the most appropriate next step in management?

options.label: C
options.text: Augment with Phenelzine and continue sertraline
